create_CollectTracepointsPass: create a CollectTracepointsPass instance with specs and sig arguments for FX graph module processing
run_CollectTracepointsPass_call: run the call method on a GraphModule to collect tracepoint inputs and outputs into specs
get_arg_spec_TensorArgument: get arg spec from an fx Node and return a TensorArgument when the node has a tensor value
get_arg_spec_ConstantArgument: get arg spec from a non-Node argument and return a ConstantArgument with its value
erase_export_tracepoint_nodes: erase _export_tracepoint nodes and their getitem users from an FX graph after collecting their specs
